description: OpenAI Ads Measurement Pixel image fallback requests to bzr.openai.com/v1/sdk/events.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the Pixel ID, and the image tag requires it.
params.fix_hint: Set `pid` to the Pixel ID from OpenAI Ads.

params.name: event
params.description: It is a supported event name, or `custom`. OpenAI documents the image tag as requiring it. `app_installed` and `app_opened` are Conversions API only.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to a documented name such as `page_viewed`, or to `custom` with `custom_event_name`.

params.name: data[type]
params.description: It names the data shape for the event. OpenAI documents it as required, matching the event.
params.fix_hint: Set `data[type]` to the shape documented for this event, such as `contents`.

params.name: custom_event_name
params.description: It names a custom event. OpenAI documents 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, and forbids standard event names.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_event_name` when `event=custom`. Do not reuse a standard event name.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It identifies the event for deduplication against the Conversions API. Use the same value as CAPI `id`.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `event_id` the Conversions API event uses as `id`.

params.name: oppref
params.description: It is an OpenAI-provided attribution identifier. The image tag does not capture it for you.
params.fix_hint: Pass `oppref` only when the page already has the value, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data[amount]
params.description: It is the event-level monetary value in the currency's minor unit. OpenAI documents an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send `data[amount]` as an integer in minor units, and send `data[currency]`.

params.name: data[currency]
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code. OpenAI documents it as required when `data[amount]` is present.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: data[plan_id]
params.description: It identifies a subscription or trial plan. OpenAI documents it on `plan_enrollment` and `custom` data.
params.fix_hint: Set `data[plan_id]` to the plan id, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data[contents]
params.description: It is the contents array, serialized as JSON and URL-encoded. OpenAI documents it on `contents`, `plan_enrollment`, and `custom` data.
params.fix_hint: Serialize the contents array as JSON, URL-encode it, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: `event` is `custom` but `custom_event_name` is missing. OpenAI documents that name as required for custom events.
rules.fix_hint: Add `custom_event_name` with the custom event name.

rules.message: The tag carries `data[amount]` with no `data[currency]`. OpenAI documents currency as required whenever amount is set.
rules.fix_hint: Add `data[currency]` as an ISO 4217 code alongside the amount.

rules.message: This event requires `data[type]=contents`. OpenAI documents that shape for page, content, cart, and order events.
This event requires `data[type]=customer_action`. OpenAI documents that shape for appointment, lead, and registration events.
This event requires `data[type]=plan_enrollment`. OpenAI documents that shape for subscription and trial events.
A `custom` event requires `data[type]=custom`. OpenAI documents that shape for custom events.
A standard event carries `custom_event_name`. OpenAI documents that parameter as required for `custom` and omitted otherwise.
`data[type]` is `customer_action` but the tag carries `data[contents]`. OpenAI documents contents as unavailable on that shape.
This data shape carries `data[plan_id]`. OpenAI documents `plan_id` on `plan_enrollment` and `custom` only.
`custom_event_name` matches a standard event name. OpenAI documents that a custom name cannot reuse a built-in event.
rules.fix_hint: Pick a name that is not a standard event, such as `quote_requested`.

rules.message: A query parameter carries what looks like a raw email address. The image tag does not support a user object, and OpenAI forbids personal data on the query string.
rules.fix_hint: Remove the address from the image tag. Send hashed identifiers on the Conversions API instead.
